summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-style `_0x...` identifiers and per-function string-lookup objects that reassemble URLs, command names, and file paths at runtime). On install it detects the host platform/arch, downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line script obfuscated with rotated string-array indirection (`n7gIxM` / `WV8StW`), hex-named identifiers, and character-code string reassembly. Neither the Bun runtime dependency nor `math_init.js` is documented in the README or CHANGELOG for what is presented as a Cypress helpers library. The alternate runtime is fetched specifically to execute the shipped obfuscated payload with a JS engine that Node-based install-time review tooling does not evaluate. This behavior fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
